label: TP
reason: The code uses java.util.Random.nextInt() to generate a session key (rememberMeKey), which is then stored in an HTTP cookie and printed directly to the response. This violates secure random number generation practices and allows predictable tokens if an attacker can predict the seed or exploit timing attacks.

evidence.note: Uses insecure java.util.Random.nextInt() to generate session token
Prints generated token directly to response without proper handling
